results.query: Tell me about the Atal Pension Yojana
results.answer:
{"answer":"Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is a savings‑based pension scheme aimed at the poor, under‑privileged and workers in the unorganized sector. It is managed by the Ministry of Finance and is available to anyone with a savings bank or post‑office savings account. The scheme is open to Indian citizens who are between 18 and 40 years of age; however, from 1 October 2022, any citizen who has been an income‑tax payer is not eligible to join. APY requires the subscriber to contribute the prescribed amount automatically (auto‑debit) from the bank account on a monthly, quarterly or half‑yearly basis, from the age of joining until 60 years.

When a subscriber turns 60, a guaranteed minimum pension is paid each month. The amount can be chosen from Rs 1 000, Rs 2 000, Rs 3 000, Rs 4 000 or Rs 5 000. After the subscriber’s death, the spouse receives the same pension amount until the spouse’s death, and after both have died the nominee receives the accumulated pension corpus. Contributions to APY are tax‑eligible under section 80CCD(1) of the Income Tax Act.

Subscribers may exit voluntarily before reaching 60 years. In that case only the contributions made (and net accrued income) are refunded, except for those who joined before 31 March 2016 and received government co‑contribution, who cannot claim the co‑contribution or accrued income. If a subscriber dies before 60 years, the spouse may either continue the subscription under the deceased’s account (option 1) or receive the entire accumulated corpus (option 2).

Application for APY can be made online through the e‑APY portal (https://enps.nsdl.com/e), via participating banks’ net banking facilities, or by visiting a bank branch. The required KYC is verified using the applicant’s Aadhaar or a virtual ID. The scheme is administered through the National Pension System (NPS) channel and a toll‑free helpline is available at 1800‑110‑069.\n\nAll information above is sourced from the Atal Pension Yojana scheme details provided above.","confidence":"high"}

results.query: What is the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana?
results.answer: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY) is a government‑sponsored social security scheme launched in 2007 and administered by the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). It aims to provide affordable life‑insurance coverage to workers in the unorganized sector, such as those in agriculture, fishery, dairy, handloom, construction and similar occupations. The scheme offers financial support to economically weaker families in the event of the earning member’s death or disability, with premiums subsidised by the central and state governments.

results.query: बीना मूल्य सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजना क्या है?
results.answer: बिना मुल्य समाजिक सुरक्षा योजना एक पश्चिम बंगाल सरकार की योजना है जिसका उद्देश्य राज्य में असंगठित श्रमिकों को व्यापक सामाजिक सुरक्षा लाभ प्रदान करना है। यह असंगठित व्यवसायों की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला को कवर करता है - निर्माण और परिवहन श्रमिकों से स्व-नियोजित व्यक्तियों जैसे कि बढ़ई, नाई, सड़क विक्रेताओं और कई अन्य - और लाभ का एक सूट प्रदान करता है, जिसमें मामूली मासिक प्रोविडेंट फंड योगदान (₹55 प्रति माह, रिटायरमेंट या मृत्यु पर ब्याज के साथ वापस लौटा), स्वास्थ्य-और-परिवार-वेल कवरेज (चिकित्सा व्यय के लिए प्रति वर्ष ₹20,000 तक) मृत्यु और विकलांगता मुआवजा (उदाहरण के लिए, आकस्मिक मृत्यु के लिए ₹2 लाख, प्राकृतिक मृत्यु के लिए ₹50,000, और आंशिक या कुल विकलांगता के लिए आंशिक रूप से बदलती हुई राशि), और उनके वर्ग के लिए ₹34,000 पेशेवर सहायता। पात्रता 18-60 साल की उम्र में वेस्ट बंगाल के निवासियों तक सीमित है, जिसमें प्रति माह ₹6,500 (निर्माण और परिवहन श्रमिकों के लिए कोई सीमा नहीं) की पारिवारिक आय सीमा शामिल है।

results.query: Explain the Airavata Scheme for taxi drivers in Karnataka
results.answer: The Karnataka Airavata Scheme is a government initiative aimed at promoting self‑employment of rural youth from SC/ST communities by enabling them to operate as taxi drivers. The scheme partners with corporate aggregators such as OLA, UBER and MERU to provide training, mentoring and other support. Beneficiaries receive a subsidy of up to Rs. 5 lakh (a 50% subsidy) to purchase a light motor vehicle, which can then be used on the aforementioned platforms or as a tourist taxi in districts where the platforms do not operate. The state government plans to cover around 1,000 SC/ST taxi drivers and has earmarked roughly ₹225 crore for the scheme. Applicants must belong to an SC/ST community, be resident of Karnataka, be above 21 years old, hold a valid driving licence and cab badge, and have a family annual income not exceeding Rs. 5 lakh. The scheme also requires a set of documents such as Aadhaar, PAN, caste certificate, etc., and the remaining amount after the 5‑lakh subsidy must be arranged by the applicant.

results.query: What documents do I need for the Amma Two Wheeler Scheme?
results.answer:
To apply for the Amma Two Wheeler Scheme for Working Women, you need to submit the following documents:

1. Proof of age (18‑40 years) or Date of Birth
2. Proof of residence (EPIC card, Driving License, Aadhaar Card, utility bill, etc.)
3. Driving License or Learner License Registration (LLR) issued by the competent authority
4. Income Certificate issued by employer or self‑certification
5. Proof of employment (if applicable) – a letter from the employer, organization, or project head
6. Aadhaar card
7. Proof of educational qualification / appearance for the VIII standard exam (e.g., transfer certificate, SSLC, etc.)
8. Passport‑size photograph
9. Proof to establish membership of any priority category (e.g., community certificate for SC/ST)
10. Differently Abled Identity Card (if applicable)
11. Quotation/pro‑forma invoice of the vehicle
12. Any other documents required as notified by the scheme.

Note that Driving License / LLR and age proof are mandatory at the time of application. Missing documents must be reported to the applicant in the acknowledgment slip.

results.query: असम अरोग्य निधि योजना के तहत क्या लाभ मिलता है?
results.answer: असम आरोग्य निधि योजना के तहत पात्र लाभार्थियों को प्राकृतिक या मानव निर्मित आपदाओं के कारण होने वाले जीवन-धमकी रोगों और चोटों के सामान्य और विशेष उपचार के लिए अधिकतम ₹3 लाख तक की वित्तीय सहायता मिलती है। इस योजना में हृदय रोगों और शल्य चिकित्सा, कैंसर, गुर्दे और मूत्र विकारों, आर्थोपेडिक समस्याओं, थैलसैमिया, हड्डी-मेरो प्रत्यारोपण, एड्स और पुरानी मानसिक बीमारी सहित स्थितियों की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला शामिल है, जिसमें शल्य चिकित्सा (असम आरोग्य निधि योजना) की आवश्यकता होती है। राशि को सीधे लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में वितरित किया जाता है या किसी बैंक हस्तांतरण के माध्यम से अस्पताल में वापस आ जाता है, अस्पताल में अग्रिम भुगतान के साथ ₹3 लाख (असम आरोग्य निधि योजना) तक सीमित होता है। चयन समिति के अध्यक्ष द्वारा ₹2 लाख तक अनुदान को मंजूरी दे दी जा सकती है, जबकि मामलों में ₹2 लाख से अधिक की सहायता की आवश्यकता होती है, जिनका निर्णय राज्य स्तरीय समिति (असम आरोग्य निधि योजना) द्वारा किया जाता है। किसी भी सरकारी अस्पताल, मेडिकल कॉलेज या तृतीयक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल सुविधा पर उपचार प्राप्त किया जा सकता है, साथ ही साथ क्लिनिकल स्थापना अधिनियम के तहत पंजीकृत निजी अस्पतालों और असम, एएए और पीएमजेवाई (असम आरोग्य निधि योजना) के अस्पतालों में भर्ती किया जा सकता है। इस योजना को भारत सरकार और असम सरकार द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से वित्त पोषित किया जाता है, प्रत्येक स्वीकृत निधि (असम आरोग्य निधि योजना) का 50 % योगदान देता है। इसे BPL परिवारों और परिवारों में लक्षित किया जाता है, जिनकी वार्षिक आय ₹5 लाख से कम है, सरकारी कर्मचारियों, पेंशनरों और उनके परिवारों को बाहर कर देता है, और आवेदकों (असम आरोग्य निधि योजना) की आयु सीमा नहीं है।

results.query: What is the process to apply for Accidental Death Assistance for Construction Workers?
results.answer:
To apply for the Accidental Death Assistance for Construction Workers scheme run by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, follow these steps:

1. **Visit the Board’s website** – Go to https://dbocwwb.delhi.gov.in/cwapp/My Login and click on “Register Now” (or “Apply for Scheme” if you already have an account).
2. **Create or use a login** – Provide your Aadhaar Card Number, name, mobile number, date of birth, gender, and other required details, then create a password to complete registration. If you already have an account, log in with your Aadhaar, registration card, or OTP.
3. **Fill in mandatory details** – Enter personal data such as father’s and mother’s names, photograph, and upload required documents (Aadhaar photocopy, first page of bank passbook or cancelled cheque, etc.).
4. **Submit work‑related information** – Provide details of your current or previous employer, proof of at least 90 days’ employment in a given year, and upload supporting documents.
5. **Add family members** – If you are claiming on behalf of a nominee/dependent, add their details and upload the required documents (death certificate, FIR or medico‑legal report, proof of relationship, etc.).
6. **Pay the registration fee** – Pay the ₹25 online fee via debit card, internet banking, or UPI.
7. **Confirm and submit** – Verify all entered information, tick the “Affidavit of the Applicant”, and submit the application. You will receive an application number and an acknowledgement receipt.
8. **Track the application** – Use the “Track Your Application” option on the website to monitor the status of your claim.

All steps are conducted online through the official DBo CWWB portal, and the scheme is administered by the Labour Department of the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

—Accidental Death Assistance for the Construction Workers scheme.

results.query: How do I claim benefits under the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana?
results.answer: Under the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY), the claim process is initiated by the beneficiary or nominee. They should contact the LIC branch office or the authorized insurance company/bank and submit a claim form along with the required documents, such as a death certificate, post‑mortem report (for accidental death) and any other supporting paperwork. The claim must be filed within 30 days of the incident. Once submitted, the claim is processed by the respective state government, and the compensation is transferred directly to the nominee’s bank account.
